title: Your future. Your path.
narration: Meet Path for You, a career and learning workspace that helps you turn a goal into a practical next step.

title: Discover and compare
narration: Enter the guest workspace and discover opportunities. Review the original source, requirements and deadline before saving anything that fits your interests.

title: Ask Path4U AI
narration: Ask a non-sensitive learning question. Path for You sends it through the server to Gemini, then presents an answer you can review.

title: Build a learning roadmap
narration: Choose cybersecurity, your starting level, weekly study time and duration. Generate a structured roadmap with learning phases, practical projects and completion criteria.

title: Save and follow the path
narration: Save the roadmap explicitly, then open its flowchart view. Both views use the same plan, so switching views needs no extra AI generation.

title: Explore the branches
narration: Create a cybersecurity mind map with Gemini. Edit the suggested branches, add connections and save the map when it reflects your learning goals.

title: Keep resume work local
narration: Resume Studio can review fictional sample text locally. Its explained quality score highlights observable gaps. It does not predict hiring success or guarantee ATS acceptance.

title: Review before you submit
narration: Use the draft library to save and edit your preparation notes. Application materials stay under your control, and submissions use the organizer’s authorized channel.

title: A fair daily AI allowance
narration: Guest sessions share four AI interactions across tools each day. Access renews at eight in the morning Malaysia time, while shared capacity and Google limits still apply.
